figures.fact: Climbers path from Hannegan Pass Trailhead to the base of the crag: should take about an hour with 1200' of gain.

note: Stored 1200 is Mountain Project's published approach gain to the crag BASE, not to the 'Top of Mamie Peak wall' pin. Comparing it with the wall-top pin is the mismatch: the gain ends at a different point than the summit pin. One source only. MP area elevation 1,862 m; WTA Hannegan page gives no trailhead elevation.
